discovered_after: Run 35342260523 failed before aggregate inference; the failing subject jobs stopped in source-channel binding before fixed-channel analysis completed
observed_failure: The adapter regex was serialized as r"[A-Za-z]+(\\\\d{3})" in Python source, which matches a literal backslash-d sequence instead of three digits. Therefore generic names such as EEG001 were not recognized and the already frozen BIDS positional binding was not applied.

correction.rule: Change only the regex escape from \\d{3} as a literal backslash-d match to the Python raw-regex digit class \d{3}.

invariants: No source EEG bytes or BIDS metadata bytes are changed.
No channel order, BIDS positional mapping, or preregistered 19-sensor mapping is changed.
No windowing, hierarchy, kappa endpoint, directional hypothesis, cohort, exclusion rule, Mann-Whitney test or alpha is changed.
No aggregate group result existed when this correction was frozen.
